Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a bonus when the leftover is a multiple of 3, so residuals divisible by 3 outrank slightly tighter ones. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when the tightest leftover is not a multiple of 3. It may help if small item sizes make multiples of 3 common remainders, or fail because divisibility by 3 is arbitrary.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (30 if (r - item) % 3 == 0 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
